rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs administered or approved by a recognized national, state or local dentistry organization, health care organization, accredited health care facility or accredited college/university, or pre-approved by the Board; teaching, publications, clinical instruction and research may count. Approved internet courses accepted
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the first renewal of a license granted by examination.

topics.who: Cultural competency or clinical training on LGBTQ patients
At least 10% of required hours in public health priority subjects named by the Director
Dentists with DEA and DC controlled substance registration: abuse/misuse of controlled substances and opioid prescribing; part of the 30 hours
Current CPR for health care providers; online CPR/BLS/PALS/ACLS accepted

rules.notes: Current CPR certification for health care providers required; online CPR/BLS/PALS/ACLS courses accepted. DC Health moved licenses to a birth-month cycle (expires last day of birth month, odd/even year per birth year); 50% CE accepted once for shortened transition terms.
